verses.1: The kingdom of Media shall be established, and the kingdom of Rome shall prevail greatly over the kingdom of Macedonia, and the kingdom of Nineveh, and over the kingdom of Persia.
verses.2: And the kingdom of Ethiopia over the kingdom of Alexandria, and the kingdom of Moab over Amalek, for they shall rise up.
verses.3: And brother shall rise up against brother, and God shall act with a word, as he spoke concerning them, that they should perish.
verses.4: And he said: kingdom shall rise up against kingdom, and people against people, and city against city.
verses.5: And there shall be strife, and there shall be killing, and famine, and confusion, and turmoil, and the scattering of winter; for peace and love have departed, and the wrath of God has come down upon her.
verses.6: And when the day of the Lord draws near, it shall come like lightning that appears from the east even to the west.
verses.7: And then each one shall be repaid according to his deeds, and according to the work of his hands, and according to the fruit of his deeds; for he himself, says the Lord, in the day of judgment they shall be reproved, and at the time when their feet stumble, for the day of their destruction has drawn near.
verses.8: Truly I say, God will destroy the evildoers who have not walked in his law, in the eternal judgment: the people of Judah, and Cyprus, and Samaria, and Damascus, and the people of Babylon.
verses.9: And those also who dwell in the deserts: Arabia, and India, and Nubia, and Sheba, and Egypt, and Ethiopia, and all who dwell upon them.
verses.10: Then he said to me: I am the Lord who created heaven and earth, and I am he who gives glory and honor, and I am he who kills and makes alive.
verses.11: And I am he who makes the sun rise and sets it in its west, and I am he who brings good and evil.
verses.12: And I am he who brings a people who are not known, who shall devour the fruit of your labor and the pasture of your cattle and your sheep.
verses.13: And your children shall be dashed to pieces before you, and they shall call to them, but you will not be able to save them; and they shall devour your offspring and your offspring's offspring, because you did not fear the commandment of God which you heard, for the spirit of God has been taken away from you.
verses.14: And he upon whom the spirit of God dwells speaks everything as it is told him, as Nebuchadnezzar the king said to Daniel the prophet: For I see the spirit of God upon you.
verses.15: For one in whom is the spirit of God speaks everything, hidden and revealed; it becomes his, and there is nothing hidden from the spirit of God, but he speaks everything, hidden and revealed.
verses.16: For we are men, we who are of dust, and we die; and our deeds which we did in secret shall all be revealed.
verses.17: As gold and silver are tested by fire, so shall sinners be tested on the last day, because they did not keep the commandment of God.
verses.18: And then the deeds of all the children of Israel and of all the nations shall be tested.
